## Base stats

Before wave scaling. **Speed** is the walking speed along the path. **Lives lost** is what an enemy costs when it reaches the exit.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Grunt | 20 | 1 px/tick (165 px/s) | $4 | 1 |
| 2 | Fast runner | 55 | 1.6 px/tick (264 px/s) | $10 | 1 |
| 3 | Bruiser | 160 | 0.9 px/tick (148.5 px/s) | $28 | 2 |
| 4 | Heavy | 420 | 0.7 px/tick (115.5 px/s) | $75 | 3 |
| 5 | Tank | 800 | 0.5 px/tick (82.5 px/s) | $200 | 5 |
| 6 | Siege tank | 1,500 | 0.4 px/tick (66 px/s) | $400 | 8 |

## Tanks

Tanks fire at the nearest ground tower in range, chipping its HP until it is destroyed. Planes can't be hit.

| # | Enemy | Range (px) | Fire interval | Shell damage | DPS |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | Tank | 280 (4.375 tiles) | 2,500 ms | 20 | 8.0 |
| 6 | Siege tank | 320 (5 tiles) | 1,800 ms | 35 | 19.4 |

## Scaling per wave

HP and kill money grow linearly with the wave: base x (1 + 0.25 x (wave - 1)), rounded down, and kill money is at least $1. Speed, lives lost and the tanks' guns don't change. Each cell is **HP / kill money** of one enemy spawned in that wave.
